purpose: S072 compact initial-state transfer and spherical static capacitance comparison

sources.reading_scope: Sections 2.3 and 3.1-3.2: compact group particle, ensembles, susceptibility matching and charge sum; appendix A.1 and A.3 KN conventions. Source omits coupling to light charged matter. Its susceptibility about an electric background is not copied into the fixed-magnetic electric direction; that coefficient is derived here. No full gluing/KK proof-chain audit.

Appendix A reread in full: massless-fermion bosonization, spherical polarization, large angular representation and gauge modes. Supplies the local Gaussian polarization coefficient, not the real-time exterior response or dressed angular inertia.
Retained magnetic sphere spectrum from the prior magnetic-product-vacuum note; equation 2.30 multiplicity reread this turn. No new determinant, supersymmetry or electric-instability result imported.

novelty: Compact symmetry modes, charge freezing, magnetic multiplets and bosonization are prior work. Explicit comparisons and bounds are ordinary calculations; no exhaustive novelty acceptance.
limitations: Angular dressing and the actual joint charge-spin lattice are not matched
Static spherical Gaussian polarization is not the full switching influence functional
Many-flavor scaling is necessary-scale compatibility, not a completed construction
next: Matched angular susceptibility and real-time compact-mode/fermion switching kernel in the many-flavor candidate.
